sentences.text:
....Respondents
Dr. Milind Sathe, Senior Advocate a/w. Jagdish G. Aradwad (Reddy),
Advocate for the Petitioner.
Mr.H.S.Venegaonkar a/w.
Mr. Aayush Kedia, Advocate

Respondent, Union of India
 Coram:- R.D. Dhanuka &
 M.M. Sathaye, Jj.
Date :- 16Th February, 2023.

The grievance of the Petitioner in this Petition is that though the structure constructed on the Plot No. 2, bearing Survey No. 752, Hissa No. 1/2 for running retail and commercial building, is not forming the part of the impugned Award dated 14th March, 2022, the Respondents are threatening the Petitioner to demolish the said structure for road widening.

Therefore, the Petitioner is seeking a writ of certiorari for quashing and setting aside the impugned Award Tikam page 1 of 3 910 WP 1932 of 2023.doc dated 14th March, 2022 passed by the Land Acquisition Collector, Daman under Section 23 of the Right to Fair Compensation &
Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013 to the extent of the Petitioner's property.

sentences.text: Mr. Venegaonkar, learned counsel for the Respondent-Union of India, tenders a copy of the draft and submitted that the Respondents have not acquired any structure on the writ property and they have not proposed to carry out any demolition.
He submits that only the affected lands are acquired under the impugned award.
4. Both the parties
have fairly agreed that there will be survey and demarcation of the writ property of the land Tikam page 2 of 3 910 WP 1932 of 2023.doc acquired under the Impugned Award.
The Petitioner has agreed to remain present at the writ property for the purpose of survey and demarcation of the writ structure with the officers of the Respondents at that time.

Mr.
Venegaonkar, learned counsel agrees that his officers will be present with the Petitioner and carry out survey and demarcate the land under acquisition.
After the demarcation and survey, the Respondents will hand over demarcation map and report within one week from the date of carrying out the demarcation and survey to the Petitioner.

5. Place the matter on the Supplementary Board under the caption 'for compliance' on 1st March,
2023.
6.

In view of the statement made by the Learned Counsel for the Respondents, Respondents shall not take possession of the structure on the writ property which is not the subject matter of the Impugned Award and/or cause any damage to the writ property.
(M.M. SATHAYE, J.) ( R.D.DHANUKA, J. )
